answer_text:
Here are some fascinating and funny weird habits that many people secretly have — you might even recognize a few of your own!

---

### 🖊️ 1. Doodling During Phone Calls
Some people doodle during phone calls to help keep themselves focused, and sometimes they don't even realize they're doing it until they're off the phone.

---

### 🗣️ 2. Talking to Inanimate Objects
Many people have the habit of talking to inanimate objects — like apologizing to a table after bumping into it, or yelling at a laptop when it freezes right in the middle of something important.

---

### 🚿 3. Rehearsing Arguments in the Shower
The shower seems to be the perfect place to rehearse arguments — the most brilliant comebacks for past conflicts always seem to surface while shampooing your hair, long after the moment has passed.

---

### 😬 4. Saying "Ow" Before Getting Hurt
Some people say "Ow" when they bang something with another object, even though it didn't actually touch or hurt them. Some even take it further and say "Ow" whether something hits them or not!

---

### 🗑️ 5. Folding Trash Neatly
Some people fold their trash — any pieces of paper, foil, chip bags, candy wrappers, paper towels, or gum wrappers — folding everything into a neat square once they're done with the contents.

---

### 🥦 6. Eating Foods Separately
Some people eat things separately — for example, eating all the chicken before touching the broccoli — and don't even realize it's considered weird until someone points it out.

---

### 🐕 7. Telling Objects to "Stay"
Some people tell breakable objects or things they don't want to misplace to "stay" out loud, like you would to a dog, and don't think it's weird until someone questions it — even though the objects couldn't listen if they wanted to.

---

### 🥛 8. Shaking Store-Bought Milk
Some people shake milk jugs before pouring, having been raised on a dairy farm where it was necessary with fresh milk — and don't realize until well into adulthood that it's not needed with store-bought milk.

---

### 👂 9. Folding Their Ear While Reading
Some people fold their ear over backwards while reading and it becomes such a habit that they don't even realize they're doing it until someone points it out.

---

### 🍫 10. Eating Non-Food Items (Pica)
On the more extreme end of the spectrum, some people have a habit of eating non-food items like dirt or chalk, known as pica. Others might have a habit of pulling out their hair or obsessively washing their hands.

---

### 🧠 11. Talking to Yourself Mid-Conversation
Some people ask others questions about a conversation they've been having entirely in their own head, only to realize mid-question that the other person wasn't part of the internal dialogue at all!

---

As humans, we're all odd in our own ways, but some of our tendencies are more common than you might think! So if you spotted yourself in a few of these, don't worry — you're definitely not alone! 😄
